entries.displayName: 3dpixel2d agent kit (the engine in one file)
entries.description: The Depthward engine distilled into one TypeScript file for AI coding agents: live 3D drawn as pixel-art sprites (low-res pass, outlines, palette lock, pixel snapping, stepped 8-way animation), a deterministic 60 Hz world, agent tools on window.agent and a playable example. Needs only three.js.
representativeQueries: single-file game engine an AI agent can read and build on
render 3D models as crisp pixel art with three.js
deterministic game loop that agents can step and capture
